title: YourRAGE Begs For Backup Mid-Fight Then Immediately Switches Up In GTA 6
caption: He swore the other guy started it and immediately yelled for backup. Watch how fast he switched up once the fight ended. #YourRAGE #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming #GTAClips
